known_conditions: THIS MANIFEST IS AN AMENDMENT, NOT A REPLACEMENT. The parent manifest docs/ops/release/CV1_INFRA_EXECUTION_DAG_TEST_MANIFEST_v1.0.0.json is left BYTE-UNCHANGED and continues to control every control it declares, EXCEPT those named under SUPERSEDED below. Where this manifest is silent, the parent controls verbatim.

SUPERSEDED PARENT CONTROLS, each replaced by a control here: P3 (rider evaluation reproducible from source) -> AP1, because P3's own description omitted the PR-into-release-branch limb; P7 (falsification sweep, exactly three loci) -> AP4, because P7 asserted a pattern-independent exact count; N-7 (required-check refusal on push-evaluated limbs) is EXTENDED, not superseded, by AN-2 to cover the PR-evaluated limb of release/commercial-v1 as well.

PARENT CONTROLS EXPLICITLY RETAINED AND NOT SUPERSEDED: P1, P2, P5, P6, P8, P9, P10 and N-1 through N-14 all continue to govern verbatim. N-6 continues to govern M-7 relative to DN-10 (O-1 coverage); it is NOT extended to O-2 coverage by this amendment, because M-7's own action does not configure required checks -- see the authority amendment's RELEASE_CHECK_PRODUCIBILITY_GAP.does_not_add_a_new_blocking_DAG_edge.

AUTHORING ARM vs EXECUTION ARM, as in the parent. Every control in this amendment is AUTHORING ARM: it checks a property of the amendment TEXT and the repository's workflow corpus, not of a future hosted act.

NO CODE IS WRITTEN. The write set is two JSON documents; writing a script or a test file would be code, which AUTHORING_ONLY forbids, exactly as the parent manifest already states for its own write set.

TWO FACTS IN THIS AMENDMENT ARE GRAPH-STRUCTURAL, NOT WORKFLOW-CORPUS FACTS. AP2 (INV-1 reachability) and AP3 (DN-0 deference / acyclicity) check the DAG's own internal consistency, independent of any hosted or workflow-corpus state, and can be verified by anyone holding this repository's git history alone.

sentinels.purpose: THE SEVEN RESTRICTED-BRANCH WORKFLOWS. ce3-entitlement-grants-real-pg-gate.yml, cl1-legal-acceptance-real-pg-gate.yml, golden-journey.yml, l1-organization-commercial-acceptance-real-pg-gate.yml, m2-real-pg-gate.yml, p1a-bootstrap-gate.yml and s3-refusal-real-pg-gate.yml each scope their pull_request trigger to branches: [integration/commercial-v1, main]. This is the exact list NB1_RELEASE_CI_PRODUCIBILITY_CORRECTION's 1/8 finding rests on. If a future measurement finds an EIGHTH workflow with the same restriction, or finds this set to have changed, the 1/8 figure must be recomputed before being cited again.

THE ONE UNRESTRICTED WORKFLOW. ci.yml's pull_request trigger carries no branches: filter at all, and is the SOLE reason release/commercial-v1 produces 1/8 rather than 0/8 on the PR-evaluated limb. If ci.yml's pull_request trigger is ever given a branches: filter that excludes release/commercial-v1, the PR-evaluated number becomes 0/8 and every statement in this amendment built on '1 of 8' must be re-derived, not adjusted by one.

THE TWO NEW EDGES. DN-1 -> DN-14 and DN-1 -> DN-15, and the corresponding additions to DN-14.prerequisites and DN-15.prerequisites. Any consumer of the amended DAG that finds DN-14 or DN-15 executed WITHOUT a fresh DN-1 measurement immediately preceding it has violated INV-1 as corrected here, regardless of what v1.0.0 alone would have permitted.

positive_controls.description: AUTHORING ARM. SUPERSEDES parent P3. THE FULL SIX-LIMB RIDER MATRIX IS RE-COMPUTABLE FROM SOURCE, INCLUDING THE RELEASE-BRANCH PR LIMB. Parsing each file under .github/workflows/ for its on: trigger keys, its pull_request branches: filter and its push branches: filter, then intersecting job names against the eight required-check names, must reproduce ALL SIX limbs: 8/8 on a PR into integration/commercial-v1, 8/8 on a PR into main, 1/8 on a PR into release/commercial-v1 (via ci.yml only), 1/8 on a push to main, 0/8 on a push to integration/commercial-v1, and 0/8 on a push to release/commercial-v1. A re-derivation that reproduces only the five limbs v1.0.0 originally stated, omitting the PR-into-release limb, does not satisfy this control -- it satisfies only the parent's narrower P3.

AUTHORING ARM. INV-1's CORRECTED NODE SET IS PROVABLY THE BFS REACHABLE SET FROM DN-1. Running a breadth-first traversal from DN-1 over the amended DAG_EDGES (the 24 edges v1.0.0 originally declared, plus DN-1 -> DN-14 and DN-1 -> DN-15 added by this amendment, excluding DN-0's own fan-out) must return exactly {DN-7, DN-8, DN-9, DN-10, DN-11, DN-12, DN-14, DN-15} -- eight nodes, no more and no fewer. A traversal returning a different set means either the corrected INV-1 statement or the edge list is wrong, and both must be reconciled before either is cited.

AUTHORING ARM. THE DN-0 DEFERENCE RULE AND DAG_NODES.prerequisites AGREE, AND THE FULL GRAPH IS ACYCLIC. Reading DN-0's outgoing edges as exactly {N : 'DN-0' in N.prerequisites} for every node N in DAG_NODES, then running Kahn's algorithm over the full 18-node graph (this deference set, plus the 24 original edges, plus the 2 new edges), must process all 18 nodes with zero remaining in-degree. A cycle, or a node left unprocessed, is a structural defect independent of any hosted fact.

AUTHORING ARM. SUPERSEDES parent P7. THE FALSIFICATION SWEEP IS PATTERN-DOCUMENTED, NOT A FIXED COUNT. Re-running BOTH the original seven-term mandating-verb pattern (must, shall, required, calls for, retarget, change the default, make X the default) and this amendment's eleven-term pattern (adding will, mandate/mandatory, necessitate, trigger, obligate, demand) against all five files of the frozen package and the ratification chain must reproduce 3 candidate loci under the narrower pattern and 8 under the broader one, and every one of the 8 must classify as NOT independently calling for a default-branch change. A control asserting a single fixed count without naming which pattern produced it does not satisfy this control.

AUTHORING ARM. RELEASE_CHECK_PRODUCIBILITY_GAP NAMES NO WORKFLOW-CORPUS CHANGE AND ADDS NO DAG EDGE. Reading the block must find zero specific file edits proposed (no exact branches: filter addition specified as the chosen fix), zero new node added to DAG_NODES, and zero new edge added into DN-10 or DN-11 beyond the two (DN-1->DN-14, DN-1->DN-15) this amendment separately and explicitly attributes to NB-2. A version of this block that quietly proposes an exact fix, or ties the gap to a new blocking edge on M-7, does not satisfy this control.

AUTHORING ARM. EVERY SUPERSEDED_PARENT_CLAUSES LOCUS RESOLVES IN THE PINNED v1.0.0 BLOB. Reading each of the eleven SPC-A entries' locus field as a key path into docs/ops/release/CV1_INFRA_EXECUTION_DAG_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json at blob 0c36474b08076a844d32da8b194be79ab17915b1 must resolve to an existing key. A dangling locus means the amendment claims to correct a field that does not exist at the pinned blob.

AUTHORING ARM. NO GRANT WAS WIDENED. Re-deriving this amendment's write set (two JSON documents under docs/ops/release/**) and its EXPLICIT_NON_AUTHORIZATIONS inheritance must find v1.0.0's twenty-four non-authorizations intact and unextended, and this amendment's own five additive non-authorizations present and unweakened. No hosted mutation, no workflow-file edit and no authenticated control-plane read may appear anywhere in the write set.

AUTHORING ARM. RBD-1 AND RBD-2 REMAIN UNANSWERED. Reading OWNER_DECISIONS_PRESERVED and the amended OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED text must find zero selection recorded for either RBD-1 or RBD-2, and RBD-2's new fourth consequence phrased as a measurement ('EXTEND satisfies O-1 ONLY') rather than as a recommendation for or against extending.

negative_controls.description: O-3/E CITED AS A FIX FOR THE RELEASE-BRANCH LIMBS IS REFUSED. Any claim that implementing ADJUDICATIONS.E (the push-triggered exact-SHA battery scoped to integration/commercial-v1) improves either of release/commercial-v1's producibility numbers (1/8 PR-evaluated, 0/8 push-evaluated) must be REFUSED. Measured: E's own verdict text names push -> integration/commercial-v1 only; it touches no pull_request trigger and no release-branch push trigger.

EXTENDS parent N-7. A REQUIRED CHECK CONFIGURED ON THE PR-EVALUATED LIMB OF release/commercial-v1 BEYOND THE ONE PRODUCIBLE NAME IS REFUSED. Configuring any of the seven names other than 'Lint, typecheck, test, build' as required on a pull-request gate targeting release/commercial-v1 must be REFUSED with STOP_RIDER_VIOLATION, on the same RIDER_PRE_1 basis N-7 already applies to push-evaluated limbs, now extended to this PR-evaluated one by the 1/8 finding.

RBD-2's EXTEND OPTION CITED AS CLOSING THE OD-4 BAR IN FULL IS REFUSED. A claim that selecting EXTEND for RBD-2 makes release/commercial-v1 satisfy O-1 THROUGH O-4 must be REFUSED. EXTEND closes O-1 only; O-2 remains unsatisfiable on the branch under the current workflow corpus regardless of RBD-2's answer, per RELEASE_CHECK_PRODUCIBILITY_GAP.

A WORKFLOW-CORPUS EDIT PROPOSED AS PART OF CLOSING RELEASE_CHECK_PRODUCIBILITY_GAP IS REFUSED HERE. Any edit to a file under .github/workflows/**, or any specific proposed branches: filter change, appearing in this amendment's write set or in RELEASE_CHECK_PRODUCIBILITY_GAP's own text as a chosen fix (rather than as an enumerated candidate shape) must be REFUSED. The gap is named, not closed, by design.

DN-17 GATED BEHIND DN-1 IS REFUSED. Any reading of the corrected INV-1 that includes DN-17 in the node set, or any execution record for DN-17 that cites a DN-1 measurement as a precondition, must be REFUSED. DN-17's asserted_non_edge is unchanged by this amendment and its independence from DN-1 is not merely preserved but restated with its own justification.

A FIXED CANDIDATE-LOCI COUNT CITED WITHOUT ITS PATTERN IS REFUSED. Any future citation of 'the falsification sweep found N loci' without naming which pattern (the seven-term or the eleven-term, or a third) produced N must be REFUSED as underspecified. The count is pattern-dependent; only the zero-mandates classification is the load-bearing, pattern-independent fact.

A REOPENING OF DEP-1's CONCLUSION UNDER COVER OF THE RECOUNT IS REFUSED. Any claim that NB5_FALSIFICATION_SWEEP_RECOUNT reopens whether M-4 is NOT_TRIGGERED must be REFUSED. The recount corrects a COUNT claim; it re-confirms, and does not revisit, DEP-1's substantive verdict.

AN EDITED v1.0.0 BYTE IS REFUSED. Any diff touching docs/ops/release/CV1_INFRA_EXECUTION_DAG_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json or docs/ops/release/CV1_INFRA_EXECUTION_DAG_TEST_MANIFEST_v1.0.0.json must be REFUSED as a violation of append_only. Corrections are additive files only, as CANDIDATE_BINDING's re-derivation confirms.

mutation_controls.description: SUPERSEDES parent MUT-8 for the widened pattern. Restate DEP-1's falsification sweep using only the original three-term reading and drop the eleven-term reading entirely. AP4 must REDDEN, naming the missing five loci and their classifications. If it stays green, the amendment silently reverted to the count it was supposed to correct.

Remove the DN-1 -> DN-14 edge while leaving DN-1 -> DN-15 in place. AP2 must REDDEN, returning a reachable set of {DN-7, DN-8, DN-9, DN-10, DN-11, DN-12, DN-15} -- seven nodes, missing DN-14 -- which does not match the corrected INV-1 statement's eight. This control exists because DN-14 and DN-15 were derived TOGETHER and a partial application of NB-2 is a distinct, cheaper-looking defect that must also be caught.

Re-add 'DN-0 -> every other node' as a literal wildcard alongside the deference rule, rather than replacing it. AP3 must REDDEN by finding the wildcard asserts an edge into DN-13, DN-16 or DN-17 that their own empty prerequisites arrays deny, reproducing NB-3's original defect underneath an apparently-fixed surface.

Restate RELEASE_CHECK_PRODUCIBILITY_GAP.what_would_close_it as a single selected fix (e.g. 'add release/commercial-v1 to the seven workflows' branches filters') rather than as enumerated candidate shapes. AP5 must REDDEN, naming the specific-fix language as exceeding the directing mission's 'do not design... here' scope limit.

Change AN-3's refusal to permit RBD-2's EXTEND option being described as satisfying 'the protected-line bar' without qualifying O-1-only. The control must REDDEN, naming the specific sentence that now overstates EXTEND's effect and tracing it back to RELEASE_BRANCH_PROTECTION_GAP's uncorrected consequence text.

Answer RBD-1 or RBD-2 directly in this amendment, on the reasoning that the corrections make one option obviously preferable. AP8 must REDDEN via OWNER_DECISIONS_PRESERVED, naming the selection as an owner act this lane has no authority to perform, regardless of how obvious the preference might appear from the corrected facts.
